import SymPy
function Base.show(io::IO, ::MIME"text/html", x::T) where {T <: SymPy.SymbolicObject}
    println(io, "<span class=\"math-left-align\" style=\"padding-left: 4px; width:0; float:left;\"> ")
    println(io, "\\[")
    println(io, sympy.latex(x))
    println(io, "\\]")
    println(io, "</span>")
end
